name: Crypto 15-minute prior-candle sign reversal
author: Nadav A. Kitron and Jonathan M. Wengrowicz
entry_long: If prior 15m close-to-close return < 0, take long for next interval
entry_short: If prior 15m return > 0, take short for next interval
exit: Flatten at next 15m close; recompute each bar
position_sizing: Unit notional in descriptive signal test
claimed_performance: Preprint reports gross edge around 1.3 bp/trade, below a 5 bp round-trip benchmark cost; not cost-positive at stated benchmark.
implementation_notes: High-frequency execution costs dominate; paper emphasizes sign prediction/AUC rather than a net executable strategy.
